name: view_difficulty_offline_match_plays_it
description: Every match the hub starts offline plays the level the hub shows (M8, contract-m8 §3; design 2.6): with the profile at Hard, Play in High Water builds the match scene's simulation at Hard (its rules name it and carry Hard's numbers: 15 lives, the creeps' and the bosses' health, the boss armour) and the Holdfast keeps 15 lives; Restart plays it again at Hard; a Try is a solo High Water at Hard; Race the caretaker plays both hollows at Hard; Duel the caretaker plays Normal, whatever the profile says. main.gd builds the offline match from match_spec's level (MatchRules.of).

steps.msg: Play builds the match at Hard, with Hard's numbers

steps.assert: scene.sim.rules['hp_pm'] == hard['hp_pm'] and scene.sim.rules['boss_hp_pm'] == hard['boss_hp_pm'] and scene.sim.rules['boss_armor_c'] == hard['boss_armor_c']
steps.msg: the creeps' and the bosses' health and the boss armour
Restart plays it again at Hard

steps.assert: scene.sim.mode == 'high_water' and scene.sim.seats.size() == 1 and scene.sim.rules['difficulty'] == 'hard' and Game.lives == 15
steps.msg: a Try is a solo High Water at Hard

steps.assert: scene.sim.mode == 'tide_race' and scene.sim.rules['difficulty'] == 'hard' and scene.sim.teams[0].lives == 15 and scene.sim.teams[1].lives == 15
steps.msg: Race the caretaker: both hollows at Hard

steps.assert: scene.sim.mode == 'undertow' and scene.sim.rules['difficulty'] == 'normal' and scene.sim.level == 0 and Game.lives == 20 and Session.difficulty_id() == 'hard'
steps.msg: Duel the caretaker plays Normal, though the profile says Hard
